profile_text.body:
monday.com is a publicly traded company headquartered in Tel Aviv, Israel, listed on a stock exchange under the ticker MNDY with a CIK of 0001845338. The company describes itself as an AI work platform where AI agents operate alongside human workers to execute, manage, and operate tasks together, with the stated goal of driving business results. Its platform is positioned around the idea that AI agents require contextual grounding before acting, and the company emphasizes enterprise-grade infrastructure covering data privacy, governance, permissions, and compliance.

The company's primary AI product, tracked here as Monday.com AI, is a Work OS that incorporates project automation and cross-functional data handling, with noted Israeli data transfer considerations relevant to users in certain jurisdictions. The site presents this as a unified environment for both human workers and AI agents, serving segments including small and medium businesses, enterprises, and nonprofits.

The held facts show 216 points of legal exposure recorded under Illinois, though no specific cases are listed in the available data. No MCP server registration is on record for the company.
